title: Ruling Record
description: Output of the Precedent Agent (PRA). Records what a specific authority decided about a specific product. Does NOT adjudicate override chains — that belongs to full adjudication.

ruling_id.description: Official ruling identifier (e.g. NY N329827, HQ H176833, CAAR-Valco-2023)

authority.description: Issuing body (e.g. CBP National Import Specialist, CAAR Mumbai, CESTAT Delhi)

authority_tier.description: Authority level — determines override weight within jurisdiction hierarchy

validity_status.description: Current validity of the ruling. 'unknown' triggers requires_human_review = true on the AA output.

superseded_by.description: Ruling ID that supersedes this one. Null if current.

validity_period_note.description: For BTIs: expiry date. For CAAR: validity term. Null if permanent or unknown.

component_ref.description: engineering handoff entity ID this ruling applies to

hs_codes_rejected_by_ruling.description: HS codes the authority explicitly rejected

gri_applied_in_ruling.description: GRI rules cited in the ruling (as stated in the ruling text)

legal_notes_cited_in_ruling.description: Section/Chapter Notes cited in the ruling

ruling_conclusion_vs_pta.description: How this ruling's code compares to the PTA baseline. 'not_applicable' if no PTA record exists for this jurisdiction yet.

override_claim_level.description: Strength of override claim. 'none' = record only, deferred to full adjudication.

ruling_deferred.description: Always true. PRA never adjudicates override chains.

extraction_source.description: Whether extracted from primary ruling PDF (preferred) or dossier (navigation aid)

raw_extract.description: Key paragraph from the ruling explaining the classification reasoning
